environment.description: Stream processor deployed on EKS cluster with public-facing ALB. Service type LoadBalancer with no ingress restrictions. ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. WebSocket endpoint /ws/stream is directly reachable from the internet. No WAF rules attached to the ALB. Kafka cluster is in the same VPC with security group allowing all traffic from the EKS node group.
